subject: general
question: A person walking at a speed of 7.2 km/h and crosses a bridge in 25 minutes. Find the length of the bridge (in metres).
solution:
Given:

A person walking at a speed of 7.2 km/h and crosses a bridge in 25 minutes.

Concept used:

1m/s = 18/5 km/h

Time × Speed = Distance

1 minute = 60 seconds

Calculation:

7.2 km/h = 7.2 ÷ 18/5 = 2 metres per second (m/s)

25 minutes = 25 × 60 = 1500 seconds 

Now, the length of the bridge = 2 × 1500 = 3000 metres

∴ The length of the bridge is 3000 metres.
